dimensions.label: Replication
dimensions.detail: single run — no replication across seeds declared (add robustness.seeds or simulation_set.seeds)

dimensions.label: Controls & calibration
dimensions.detail: 1 control(s) declared but none recorded a discriminating result

dimensions.label: Alternative hypotheses
dimensions.detail: 3 alternative(s) listed but none excluded yet

dimensions.label: Falsifiability
dimensions.detail: a 'how this could fail' note is declared

dimensions.label: Engineered vs emergent
dimensions.detail: no interpretation-tier claim that requires the distinction

dimensions.label: Limitations stated
dimensions.detail: states what the result does not show

dimensions.label: Next steps
dimensions.detail: no discovery_implications or follow_up_studies — state what this study changes and what to investigate next (the Decide phase)

dimensions.label: Threshold provenance
dimensions.detail: 2 of 2 numeric band(s) declare neither cites nor pass_if.provenance.kind — state where the cutoff came from (theory/calibration/literature/expert/exploratory/post_hoc)

dimensions.label: Metric calibration ladder
dimensions.detail: no calibration_ladder declared — index controls[] by known_fail / known_pass / borderline / stress rungs so the metric is calibrated across its range, not just asserted

dimensions.label: Generality
dimensions.detail: no generality axes tested — add findings[].generality.axes_tested or a robustness parameter sweep so the claim's breadth is evidenced

dimensions.label: Run persistence
dimensions.detail: no runs recorded — nothing to persist via an emitter
